countedBy: lane landmarks-r16-20261123 from the rectified panorama TMX7316010203-001981_pano_0000_000228 (2021, frontal, w01-300.jpg), the north block; lane landmarks-r17-20261123 recounted it and added the stair tower, the seven full curve facets (w08-w13, TMX7316010203-001981_pano_0000_000196 to _000225, 2021) and the south end (w07-285, w15-285) as their own spans (alongM, metres from the face's west end along bearing 300), because r16's single facade with no span measured the whole 76 m curve against the north block's rows. Glazed windows only, bottom row first. Not yet blind-counted.

facades.name: north block (Oudezijds Achterburgwal)

mixedRows.evidence: w01-300.jpg (TMX7316010203-001981_pano_0000_000228, 2021-01-25, 50 px/m): the attic storey's twelve windows stand in four groups of three, x 149-186, 205-244, 262-301 | 369-408, 426-465, 481-521 | 588-627, 645-685, 701-741 | 810-847, 867-905, 925-960 px (1.13 m pitch in a group, 4.4 m between group centres); the wider gaps are brick piers under the group headers, not missing windows. Widths listed are the glass inside the white frames.

facades.note: The attic row is grouped (mixedRows row 4).

facades.name: stair tower (Oudezijds Achterburgwal)
facades.note: w06-300.jpg (TMX7316010203-001981_pano_0000_000196, 2021): the leaded stair window (seven tiers of three lights) is drawn in copper-toned leaded glass and not counted as glass; the three small windows under hoods at the top are.

facades.name: curve facets (Oudezijds Achterburgwal)
facades.note: Seven 5.1 m facets (3DBAG ring edges 5-29) facing 285-298, measured along bearing 300 (widths shrink by up to 3.5%). Per facet: a dark-wood window in the granite base, three wide white windows, four attic windows, a dormer; edge 29's dormer is not drawn (under the bridge and tree in w13-285, no evidence of it).

mixedRows.evidence: w12-290.jpg and w09-293.jpg (TMX7316010203-001981_pano_0000_000199 and _000225, 2021-01-25, 50 px/m): four attic windows per facet at x 12-53, 69-112, 128-171, 187-229 px (w12; w09: 13-58, 72-117, 132-177, 192-235), a 1.16 m pitch, with brick at both facet ends and the 0.44 m pilaster (ring edges 6-8, 10-12, ...) between facets, so each facet's four form a group; the wider gaps are those piers, not missing windows. Widths listed are the glass inside the white frames.

facades.name: south end (Oudezijds Achterburgwal)
facades.note: The narrow facet (edge 33, 2.76 m: a narrower wood window and wide window) and the south end (edge 37, w07-285: the low block's wood and wide windows, the 24 m tower's narrow windows at three levels and a pair at the top). Row 4 mixes the narrow facet's attic lights with the tower window (mixedRows).

mixedRows.evidence: w07-285.jpg (TMX7316010203-001981_pano_0000_000202, 2021-01-25, 50 px/m): the south tower's narrow two-over-one windows stand at their own three levels (x 370-435 px; y 315-440, 500-625, 685-810), so the highest one shares a row with the narrow facet's two attic lights. The narrow facet (ring edge 33, 2.76 m) has no crop of its own (under the brief's 4 m wall minimum); its two attic lights follow the full facets' attic row (w12-290).
